units.source_text: 行到贺茂川畔时，十七夜的月亮已经上升，前驱的火把暗淡无光。

en.t: By the time they reached the bank of the Kamo River, the moon of the seventeenth night had already risen, and the torches of the outriders had grown dim.

units.source_text: 遥望鸟边野[\[31\]](#part1333.html#m31)方面，景象异常凄惨。

en.t: Looking far off toward Toribeno[\[31\]](#part1333.html#m31), the scene appeared extraordinarily bleak and sorrowful.

units.source_text: 但今宵因有重大心事，全不觉得可怕；一路上只是胡思乱想，好容易到达东山。

en.t: But tonight, because his heart was burdened with grave concerns, he felt no fear at all; lost in troubled thoughts all along the way, he at last reached Higashiyama.

units.source_text: 这沉寂的空山中有一所板屋，旁边建着一座佛堂，那老尼姑在此修行，生涯好不凄凉！

en.t: In this silent, deserted mountain stood a plank hut, with a Buddhist hall built beside it; the old nun practiced her devotions here, and how desolate her life was.

units.source_text: 佛前的灯从屋内漏出微光，板屋里有一个女人正在哭泣。

en.t: The lamp before the Buddha leaked a faint glow from inside the room, and in the plank hut a woman was weeping.

units.source_text: 外室里有两三位法师，有时谈话，有时放低了声音念佛。

en.t: In the outer room were two or three monks, sometimes talking, sometimes lowering their voices to chant the Buddha's name.

units.source_text: 山中各寺院的初夜诵经都已完毕，四周肃静无声。

en.t: The first-night sutra chanting at the temples in the mountains had all ended, and everything around was solemn and silent.

units.source_text: 只有清水寺方面还望得见许多灯光，参拜者甚多。

en.t: Only in the direction of Kiyomizu Temple could many lights still be seen, for there were still many worshippers there.

units.source_text: 这里的老尼姑有一个儿子，出家修行，已成高僧，此时正用悲紧之声虔诵经文。

en.t: The old nun here had a son who had entered religion, practiced austerities, and become a distinguished monk; at this moment he was reverently reciting scripture in a tense, sorrowful voice.

units.source_text: 源氏公子听了，悲从中来，泪如泉涌。

en.t: When Prince Genji heard it, grief rose from within him, and his tears poured out like a spring.

units.source_text: 走进室内，但见右近背着灯火，与夕颜的遗骸隔着屏风，俯伏在地。

en.t: When he went inside, he saw Ukon with her back to the lamplight, separated from Yugao's remains by a screen and lying prostrate on the floor.

units.source_text: 源氏公子推想她心情何等颓丧！

en.t: Prince Genji imagined how utterly crushed her heart must be.

units.source_text: 夕颜的遗骸并不可怕，却非常可爱，较之生前毫无变异。

en.t: Yugao's remains were not frightening at all, but instead very lovely, unchanged in the least from when she was alive.

units.source_text: 源氏公子握住了她的手说：“请让我再听一听你的声音！

en.t: Prince Genji took her hand and said, "Please let me hear your voice once more!

units.source_text: 你我两人前生结下何等宿缘，故而今生欢会之期如此短暂，而我对你却又如此倾心爱慕？

en.t: What bond from a former life did the two of us form, that our time of joy in this life should be so brief, while I have loved you so deeply?

units.source_text: 如今你匆匆舍我而去，使我形单影只，悲恸无穷，真是太残酷了！”

en.t: Now you have hastily abandoned me and gone, leaving me all alone and endlessly grief-stricken; it is truly too cruel!"

units.source_text: 他不惜声泪，号啕大哭，不能自已。

en.t: He held back neither voice nor tears, but sobbed aloud and could not control himself.

units.source_text: 僧人等不识此是何人，但觉异常感动，大家陪着流泪。

en.t: The monks did not know who he was, but they were deeply moved, and all wept along with him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子哭罢，对右近说：“你跟我到二条院去吧。”

en.t: When Prince Genji had finished weeping, he said to Ukon, "Come with me to Nijo-in."

units.source_text: 右近说：“我从小服侍小姐，片刻不离左右，至今已历多年。

en.t: Ukon said, "I have served my lady since I was small, never leaving her side for even a moment, and many years have passed like this until now.

units.source_text: 如今匆匆诀别，教我回到哪里去呢？

en.t: Now that we have suddenly parted forever, where am I supposed to return?

units.source_text: 别人问我小姐下落，教我怎么回答呢？

en.t: If others ask me where my lady has gone, how am I supposed to answer?

units.source_text: 我心悲伤，自不必说，若外人纷纷议论，将此事归罪于我，实在使我痛心！”

en.t: It goes without saying that my heart is full of sorrow, but if outsiders gossip and blame me for this, it will truly break my heart!"

units.source_text: 说罢，大哭不已。

en.t: After saying this, she kept sobbing without end.

units.source_text: 后来又说：“让我和小姐一同化作灰尘吧！”

en.t: Then she said again, "Let me turn to ashes together with my lady!"

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“怪不得你。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "I cannot blame you.

units.source_text: 但此乃人世常态，凡是离别，无不悲哀。

en.t: But this is the way of the human world; every parting is sorrowful.

units.source_text: 然而不论这般那般，尽属前生命定。

en.t: Yet whatever happens, all of it belongs to destiny fixed in a former life.

units.source_text: 你且宽心，信任我吧。”

en.t: For now, set your heart at ease and trust me."

units.source_text: 他一面抚慰右近，一面又叹道：“说这话的我，才真觉得活不下去了！”

en.t: As he comforted Ukon, he sighed again, "I am the one saying these things, yet I truly feel I cannot go on living!"

units.source_text: 这话真好凄凉啊！

en.t: How terribly sorrowful those words were.

units.source_text: 此时惟光催促道：“天快亮了。

en.t: At this moment Koremitsu urged him, saying, "Daybreak is near.

units.source_text: 务请公子早归！”

en.t: Please, my lord, return as soon as you can!"

units.source_text: 公子留恋不忍遽去，屡屡回头，终于硬着心肠离去了。

en.t: The prince lingered, unable to leave at once, and looked back again and again, until at last he hardened his heart and departed.
